title: Kamisato Ayaka
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Kamisato Art: Hyouka
sections.body:
Summons blooming ice to launch nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

"Clouds shroud the moonlit night. Longing descends like a fog, filling the one detained with wanderlust."

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Kamisato Art: Senho
sections.body:
Alternate Sprint
Ayaka consumes Stamina and cloaks herself in a frozen fog that moves with her.

In Senho form, she moves swiftly upon water.
When she reappears, the following effects occur:
·Ayaka unleashes frigid energy to apply Cryo on nearby opponents.
·Coldness condenses around Ayaka's blade, infusing her attacks with Cryo for a brief period.

"Feathers fleeting wet / the white heron treads water / a sight without flaw"

sections.title: C1 · Snowswept Sakura
sections.body: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal Cryo DMG to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.

sections.title: C2 · Blizzard Blade Seki no To
sections.body: When casting Kamisato Art: Soumetsu, unleashes 2 smaller additional Frostflake Seki no To, each dealing 20% of the original storm's DMG.

sections.title: C3 · Frostbloom Kamifubuki
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Soumetsu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Ebb and Flow
sections.body: Opponents damaged by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu's Frostflake Seki no To will have their DEF decreased by 30% for 6s.

sections.title: C5 · Blossom Cloud Irutsuki
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Dance of Suigetsu
sections.body: Kamisato Ayaka gains Usurahi Butou every 10s, increasing her Charged Attack DMG by 298%. This buff will be cleared 0.5s after Ayaka's Charged ATK hits an opponent, after which the timer for this ability will restart.

sections.title: Passive · Amatsumi Kunitsumi Sanctification
sections.body: After using Kamisato Art: Hyouka, Kamisato Ayaka's Normal and Charged Attacks deal 30% increased DMG for 6s.

sections.title: Passive · Kanten Senmyou Blessing
sections.body:
When the Cryo application at the end of Kamisato Art: Senho hits an opponent, Kamisato Ayaka gains the following effects:
·Restores 10 Stamina
·Gains 18% Cryo DMG Bonus for 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Fruits of Shinsa
sections.body: When Ayaka crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

title: Jean
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Gale Blade
sections.body:
Focusing the might of the formless wind around her blade, Jean releases a miniature storm, launching opponents in the direction she aims at, dealing massive Anemo DMG.

Hold
At the cost of continued stamina consumption, Jean can command the whirlwind to pull surrounding opponents and objects towards her front.
Direction can be adjusted.
Character is immobile during skill duration.

That which follows Jean, the wholehearted defender, is a guardian wind that can banish danger from her comrades' presence.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Dandelion Breeze
sections.body:
Calling upon the wind's protection, Jean creates a swirling Dandelion Field, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Anemo DMG.
At the same time, she instantly regenerates a large amount of HP for all party members. The amount of HP restored scales off Jean's ATK.

Dandelion Field
·Continuously regenerates HP of characters within the AoE and continuously imbues them with Anemo.
·Deals Anemo DMG to opponents entering or exiting the Dandelion Field.

Jean's magnanimity is as vast as the dandelion fields, and it is the root of her wish to protect others.

sections.title: C1 · Spiraling Tempest
sections.body: Increases the pulling speed of Gale Blade after holding for more than 1s, and increases the DMG dealt by 40%.

sections.title: C2 · People's Aegis
sections.body: When Jean picks up an Elemental Orb/Particle, all party members have their Movement SPD and ATK SPD increased by 15% for 15s.

sections.title: C3 · When the West Wind Arises
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Dandelion Breeze by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Lands of Dandelion
sections.body: Within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze, all opponents have their Anemo RES decreased by 40%.

sections.title: C5 · Outbursting Gust
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Gale Blade by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Lion's Fang, Fair Protector of Mondstadt
sections.body: Incoming DMG is decreased by 35% within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze. Upon leaving the Dandelion Field, this effect lasts for 3 attacks or 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Wind Companion
sections.body: On hit, Jean's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance to regenerate HP equal to 15% of Jean's ATK for all party members.

sections.title: Passive · Let the Wind Lead
sections.body: Using Dandelion Breeze will regenerate 20% of its Energy.

sections.title: Passive · Guiding Breeze
sections.body: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

title: Lisa
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Violet Arc
sections.body:
#Channels the power of lightning to sweep bothersome matters away.

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
Releases a homing Lightning Orb.
On hit, it deals Electro DMG and applies a stack of the Conductive status (max 3 stacks) to opponents in a small AoE.

Hold
After an extended casting time, calls down lightning from the heavens, dealing massive Electro DMG to all nearby opponents.
Deals great amounts of extra damage to opponents based on the number of Conductive stacks applied to them, and clears their Conductive status.

Electro Purple is the raiment of the Witch of Purple Rose.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Lightning Rose
sections.body:
Summons a Lightning Rose that unleashes powerful lightning bolts, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Electro DMG.
The Lightning Rose will continuously emit lightning to knock back opponents and deal Electro DMG throughout the ability's duration.

This rose is beautiful, but beware its mortal thorns.

sections.title: C1 · Infinite Circuit
sections.body:
Lisa regenerates 2 Energy for every opponent hit while holding Violet Arc.
A maximum of 10 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

sections.title: C2 · Electromagnetic Field
sections.body:
Holding Violet Arc has the following effects:
·Increases DEF by 25%.
·Increases Lisa's resistance to interruption.

sections.title: C3 · Resonant Thunder
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Lightning Rose by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Plasma Eruption
sections.body: Lightning Rose now unleashes 1-3 lightning bolts when it attacks.

sections.title: C5 · Electrocute
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Violet Arc by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Pulsating Witch
sections.body:
When Lisa takes the field, she applies 3 stacks of Violet Arc's Conductive status onto nearby opponents.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

sections.title: Passive · Induced Aftershock
sections.body: Hits by Charged Attacks apply Violet Arc's Conductive status to opponents.

sections.title: Passive · Static Electricity Field
sections.body: Opponents hit by Lightning Rose have their DEF decreased by 15% for 10s.

sections.title: Passive · General Pharmaceutics
sections.body: When Lisa crafts a potion, she has a 20% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

title: Barbara
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Let the Show Begin♪
sections.body:
Summons water droplets resembling musical notes that form a Melody Loop, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and applying the Wet status to them.

Melody Loop
·On hit, Barbara's Normal Attacks heal your own party members and nearby teammates for a certain amount of HP, which scales with Barbara's Max HP.
·On hit, Barbara's Charged Attack generates 4 times the amount of healing.
·Periodically regenerates your own active character's HP.
·Applies the Wet status to the character and to opponents who come in contact with them.

Barbara's music is the magic that heals her companions.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Shining Miracle♪
sections.body:
Heals your own party members and nearby teammates for a large amount of HP that scales with Barbara's Max HP.

Barbara's desire to heal strengthens her will to fight and sing.

sections.title: C1 · Gleeful Songs
sections.body: Barbara regenerates 1 Energy every 10s.

sections.title: C2 · Vitality Burst
sections.body:
Decreases the CD of Let the Show Begin♪ by 15%.
During the ability's duration, your active character gains a 15% Hydro DMG Bonus.

sections.title: C3 · Star of Tomorrow
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Shining Miracle♪ by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Attentiveness Be My Power
sections.body:
Every opponent Barbara hits with her Charged Attack regenerates 1 Energy for her.
A maximum of 5 energy can be regenerated in this manner with any one Charged Attack.

sections.title: C5 · The Purest Companionship
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Let the Show Begin♪ by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Dedicating Everything to You
sections.body:
When Barbara is in the party but not on the field, and one of your own party members falls:
·Automatically revives the fallen character.
·Fully restores the revived character's HP to 100%.
This effect can only occur once every 15 mins.

sections.title: Passive · Glorious Season
sections.body: The Stamina Consumption of characters within Let the Show Begin♪'s Melody Loop is reduced by 12%.

sections.title: Passive · Encore
sections.body:
When your active character gains an Elemental Orb/Particle, the duration of the Melody Loop of Let the Show Begin♪ is extended by 1s.
The maximum extension is 5s.

sections.title: Passive · With My Whole Heart♪
sections.body: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

title: Kaeya
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Frostgnaw
sections.body:
Unleashes a frigid blast, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in front of Kaeya.

Kaeya seems affable, but his nature is that of unyielding ice.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Glacial Waltz
sections.body:
Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him.
These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration.

A winsome smile, genial words, and the merciless hoarfrost that lies beneath... These are all Kaeya's weapons.

sections.title: C1 · Excellent Blood
sections.body: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

sections.title: C2 · Never-Ending Performance
sections.body: While Glacial Waltz is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

sections.title: C3 · Dance of Frost
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Frostgnaw by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Frozen Kiss
sections.body:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.

sections.title: C5 · Frostbiting Embrace
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Glacial Waltz by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Glacial Whirlwind
sections.body: Glacial Waltz will generate 1 additional icicle, and will regenerate 15 Energy when cast.

sections.title: Passive · Cold-Blooded Strike
sections.body: Every hit with Frostgnaw regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.

sections.title: Passive · Glacial Heart
sections.body:
Opponents Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles.
Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.

sections.title: Passive · Hidden Strength
sections.body:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

title: Diluc
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Searing Onslaught
sections.body:
Performs a forward slash that deals Pyro DMG.

This skill can be consecutively used 3 times.
Enters CD if not cast again within a short period.

The slashes represent the values that Diluc holds dear: one for justice, one for courage, and one for duty.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Dawn
sections.body:
Releases intense flames to knock back nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG. The flames then converge into the weapon, summoning a Phoenix that flies forward and deals massive Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path. The Phoenix explodes upon reaching its destination, causing a large amount of AoE Pyro DMG.
The searing flames that run down his blade cause it to be infused with Pyro.

The only reason to walk in the darkness is to light it up. Behold, that fleeing light in the dead of night is the herald of the coming dawn.

sections.title: C1 · Conviction
sections.body: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.

sections.title: C2 · Searing Ember
sections.body:
When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s.
This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.

sections.title: C3 · Fire and Steel
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Searing Onslaught by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Flowing Flame
sections.body:
Casting Searing Onslaught in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt.
2s after casting Searing Onslaught, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.

sections.title: C5 · Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Dawn by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark
sections.body:
After casting Searing Onslaught, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%.
Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.

sections.title: Passive · Relentless
sections.body: Diluc's Charged Attack Stamina Cost is decreased by 50%, and its duration is increased by 3s.

sections.title: Passive · Blessing of Phoenix
sections.body: The Pyro Infusion provided by Dawn lasts for 4s longer. Additionally, Diluc gains 20% Pyro DMG Bonus during the duration of this effect.

sections.title: Passive · Tradition of the Dawn Knight
sections.body: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Claymore-type weapons.

title: Razor
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Claw and Thunder
sections.body:
#Hunts his prey using the techniques taught to him by his master and his lupical.

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
Swings the Thunder Wolf Claw, dealing Electro DMG to opponents in front of Razor.
Upon striking an opponent, Razor will gain an Electro Sigil, which increases his Energy Recharge rate.
Razor can have up to 3 Electro Sigils simultaneously, and gaining a new Electro Sigil refreshes their duration.

Hold
Gathers Electro energy to unleash a lightning storm over a small AoE, causing massive Electro DMG, and clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils.
Each Electro Sigil cleared in this manner will be converted into Energy for Razor.

In the moment when lightning strikes, you can sometimes glimpse the look of a predator sizing up his prey deep within Razor's eyes.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Lightning Fang
sections.body:
Summons the Wolf Within, which deals Electro DMG to all nearby opponents. This clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils, which will be converted into Elemental Energy for him.
The Wolf Within will fight alongside Razor for the skill's duration.

The Wolf Within
·Strikes alongside Razor's normal attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
·Raises Razor's ATK SPD and Electro RES.
·Causes Razor to be immune to DMG inflicted by the Electro-Charged status.
·Disables Razor's Charged Attacks.
·Increases Razor's resistance to interruption.

These effects end when Razor leaves the battlefield.
When Razor leaves the field, a maximum of 10 Energy will be returned to him based off the duration remaining on this skill.

The wolf has awoken. The hunt is on.

sections.title: C1 · Wolf's Instinct
sections.body: Picking up an Elemental Orb or Particle increases Razor's DMG by 10% for 8s.

sections.title: C2 · Suppression
sections.body: Increases CRIT Rate against opponents with less than 30% HP by 10%.

sections.title: C3 · Soul Companion
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Lightning Fang by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Bite
sections.body: #When casting Claw and Thunder ({LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}), opponents hit will have their DEF decreased by 15% for 7s.

sections.title: C5 · Sharpened Claws
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Claw and Thunder by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Lupus Fulguris
sections.body:
Every 10s, Razor's sword charges up, causing the next Normal Attack to release lightning that deals 100% of Razor's ATK as Electro DMG.
When Razor is not using Lightning Fang, a lightning strike on an opponent will grant Razor an Electro Sigil for Claw and Thunder.

sections.title: Passive · Awakening
sections.body:
Decreases Claw and Thunder's CD by 18%.
Using Lightning Fang resets the CD of Claw and Thunder.

sections.title: Passive · Hunger
sections.body: When Razor's Energy is below 50%, increases Energy Recharge by 30%.

sections.title: Passive · Wolvensprint
sections.body:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

sections.title: Passive · Witch's Eve Rite: Surge of Lightning
sections.body:
After completing Witch's Homework: Of the Little Wolf Pack, Razor will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.
Additionally, Razor's Elemental Burst Lightning Fang is enhanced: The Wolf Within's DMG dealt is increased by 70% of Razor's ATK.

Hexerei: Secret Rite
While the Wolf Within summoned by Razor's Elemental Burst Lightning Fang is active, if the Electro Sigils from Razor's Elemental Skill Claw and Thunder overflow, the Wolf Within will call down a lightning strike on nearby enemies, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 150% of Razor's ATK and restoring 7 Energy to Razor. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

title: Amber
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Explosive Puppet
sections.body:
The ever-reliable Baron Bunny takes the stage.

Baron Bunny
·Continuously taunts the enemy, drawing their fire.
·Baron Bunny's HP scales with Amber's Max HP.
·When destroyed or when its timer expires, Baron Bunny explodes, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Hold
Adjusts the throwing direction of Baron Bunny.
The longer the button is held, the further the throw.

Baron Bunny hails from a storied lineage, but Amber has stopped keeping count since Baron Bunny the 893rd.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Fiery Rain
sections.body:
Fires off a shower of arrows, dealing continuous AoE Pyro DMG.

Amber's passion truly burns hot.

sections.title: C1 · One Arrow to Rule Them All
sections.body: Fires 2 arrows per Aimed Shot. The second arrow deals 20% of the first arrow's DMG.

sections.title: C2 · Bunny Triggered
sections.body:
Baron Bunny, new and improved! Hitting Baron Bunny's foot with a fully-charged Aimed Shot manually detonates it.
Explosion via manual detonation deals 200% additional DMG.

sections.title: C3 · It Burns!
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Fiery Rain by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · It's Not Just Any Doll...
sections.body: Decreases Explosive Puppet's CD by 20%. Adds 1 additional charge.

sections.title: C5 · It's Baron Bunny!
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Explosive Puppet by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Wildfire
sections.body: Fiery Rain increases all party members' Movement SPD by 15% and ATK by 15% for 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Every Arrow Finds Its Target
sections.body: Increases the CRIT Rate of Fiery Rain by 10% and widens its AoE by 30%.

sections.title: Passive · Precise Shot
sections.body: Aimed Shot hits on weak points increase ATK by 15% for 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Gliding Champion
sections.body:
Decreases gliding Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

title: Venti
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Skyward Sonnet
sections.body:
#O wind upon which all hymns and songs fly, bear these earth-walkers up into the sky!

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
Summons a Wind Domain at the opponent's location, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching opponents into the air.

Hold
Summons an even larger Wind Domain with Venti as the epicenter, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching affected opponents into the air.
After unleashing the Hold version of this ability, Venti rides the wind into the air.

Opponents hit by Skyward Sonnet will fall to the ground slowly.

In the days when gods and men walked the earth together, the heavens were filled with countless songs. This melody has long since been forgotten.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Wind's Grand Ode
sections.body:
Fires off an arrow made of countless coalesced winds, creating a huge Stormeye that sucks in opponents and deals continuous Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Stormeye comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

Many hymns written in praise of the Anemo Archon have been lost to time. This one sings of his mastery over the wind.

sections.title: C1 · Splitting Gales
sections.body: Fires 2 additional arrows per Aimed Shot, each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG.

sections.title: C2 · Breeze of Reminiscence
sections.body:
Skyward Sonnet decreases opponents' Anemo RES and Physical RES by 12% for 10s.
Opponents launched by Skyward Sonnet suffer an additional 12% Anemo RES and Physical RES decrease while airborne.

sections.title: C3 · Ode to Thousand Winds
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Wind's Grand Ode by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Hurricane of Freedom
sections.body: When Venti picks up an Elemental Orb or Particle, he receives a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.

sections.title: C5 · Concerto dal Cielo
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Skyward Sonnet by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Storm of Defiance
sections.body:
Targets who take DMG from Wind's Grand Ode have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

sections.title: Passive · Embrace of Winds
sections.body: Holding Skyward Sonnet creates an upcurrent that lasts for 20s.

sections.title: Passive · Stormeye
sections.body:
Regenerates 15 Energy for Venti after the effects of Wind's Grand Ode end.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, this also restores 15 Energy to all characters of that corresponding element in the party.

sections.title: Passive · Windrider
sections.body:
Decreases gliding Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

sections.title: Passive · Witch's Eve Rite: Temporal Wind's Eulogy
sections.body:
After completing Witch's Homework: Of the Waking of Wind, Venti will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

Hexerei: Secret Rite
While the Stormeye created by the Elemental Burst Wind's Grand Ode is active, for 4s after a nearby active character triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, that character's DMG is increased by 50%, and Venti's Stormeye deals 135% of its original DMG.

title: Xiangling
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Guoba Attack
sections.body:
Summons Guoba, who will continuously breathe fire at opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Guoba loves to eat spicy food. Problem is, his stomach can't handle something this spicy.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Pyronado
sections.body:
Displaying her mastery over both fire and polearms, Xiangling sends a Pyronado whirling around her.
The Pyronado will move with your character for the ability's duration, dealing Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path.

There will never be enough heat. Never.

sections.title: C1 · Crispy Outside, Tender Inside
sections.body: Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their Pyro RES reduced by 15% for 6s.

sections.title: C2 · Oil Meets Fire
sections.body: The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

sections.title: C3 · Deepfry
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Pyronado by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Slowbake
sections.body: Pyronado's duration is increased by 40%.

sections.title: C5 · Guoba Mad
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Guoba Attack by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Condensed Pyronado
sections.body: For the duration of Pyronado, all party members receive a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus.

sections.title: Passive · Crossfire
sections.body: Increases the flame range of Guoba by 20%.

sections.title: Passive · Beware, It's Super Hot!
sections.body: When Guoba Attack's effect ends, Guoba leaves a chili pepper on the spot where it disappeared. Picking up a chili pepper increases ATK by 10% for 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Chef de Cuisine
sections.body: When Xiangling cooks an ATK-boosting dish perfectly, she has a 12% chance to receive double the product.

title: Beidou
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Tidecaller
sections.body:
#Nothing to worry about. Should anyone raise a hand against her or her men, she will avenge it ten-fold with sword and thunder.

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
Accumulating the power of lightning, Beidou swings her blade forward fiercely, dealing Electro DMG.

Hold
Lifts her weapon up as a shield. Max DMG absorbed scales off Beidou's Max HP.
Attacks using the energy stored within the greatsword upon release or once this ability's duration expires, dealing Electro DMG. DMG dealt scales with the number of times Beidou is attacked in the skill's duration. The greatest DMG Bonus will be attained once this effect is triggered twice.
The shield possesses the following properties:
·Has 250% Electro DMG Absorption Efficiency.
·Applies the Electro element to Beidou upon activation.

Conquer the high seas! Pursue the waves and chase the storm!

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Stormbreaker
sections.body:
Recalling her slaying of the great beast Haishan, Beidou calls upon that monstrous strength and the lightning to create a Thunderbeast's Targe around herself, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Thunderbeast's Targe
·When Normal and Charged Attacks hit, they create a lightning discharge that can jump between opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption, and decreases DMG taken.

A maximum of 1 lightning discharge can be triggered per second.

With a peal of thunder, Haishan is slain.

sections.title: C1 · Sea Beast's Scourge
sections.body:
When Stormbreaker is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 16% of Beidou's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs Electro DMG 250% more effectively.

sections.title: C2 · Upon the Turbulent Sea, the Thunder Arises
sections.body: Stormbreaker's arc lightning can jump to 2 additional targets.

sections.title: C3 · Summoner of Storm
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Tidecaller by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Stunning Revenge
sections.body: Upon being attacked, Beidou's Normal Attacks gain an additional instance of 20% Electro DMG for 10s.

sections.title: C5 · Crimson Tidewalker
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Stormbreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Bane of Evil
sections.body: During the duration of Stormbreaker, the Electro RES of surrounding opponents is decreased by 15%.

sections.title: Passive · Retribution
sections.body: Counterattacking with Tidecaller at the precise moment when the character is hit grants the maximum DMG Bonus.

sections.title: Passive · Lightning Storm
sections.body:
Gain the following effects for 10s after unleashing Tidecaller with its maximum DMG Bonus: 
·DMG dealt by Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%. ATK SPD of Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%.
·Greatly reduced delay before unleashing Charged Attacks.

sections.title: Passive · Conqueror of Tides
sections.body:
Decreases swimming Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

sections.title: Passive · Polaris
sections.body:
When holding down on the Elemental Skill Tidecaller, 1 stack of power will accumulate every 0.8s, even when not under attack. This increases the DMG dealt at the point of unleashing.
Additionally, holding down to unleash Tidecaller and hitting the opponent also gives extra boosts based on the power accumulated: every stack active decreases Beidou's Elemental Skill CD by 4s, as well as regenerates 8 Elemental Energy for her. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, when inside a Polestar Field, Beidou will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.

title: Xingqiu
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
sections.body:
Xingqiu performs twin strikes with his sword, dealing Hydro DMG. At the same time, this ability creates the maximum number of Rain Swords, which will orbit your active character.
The Rain Swords have the following properties:
·When a character takes DMG, the Rain Sword will shatter, reducing the amount of DMG taken.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption.

20% of Xingqiu's Hydro DMG Bonus will be converted to additional DMG Reduction for the Rain Swords.

The maximum amount of additional DMG Reduction that can be gained this way is 24%.
The initial maximum number of Rain Swords is 3.
Using this ability applies the Wet status onto the character.

"Easier to slay a rain dragon than to sever the rain."

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Guhua Sword: Raincutter
sections.body:
Initiate Rainbow Bladework and fight using an illusory sword rain, while creating the maximum number of Rain Swords.

Rainbow Bladework
·Your active character's Normal Attacks will trigger consecutive sword rain attacks, dealing Hydro DMG.
·Rain Swords will remain at the maximum number throughout the ability's duration.

The "Way of the Rain Cutter" is one of the esoteric secret techniques of the Guhua Sect.

sections.title: C1 · The Scent Remained
sections.body: Increases the maximum number of Rain Swords by 1.

sections.title: C2 · Rainbow Upon the Azure Sky
sections.body:
Extends the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3s.
Decreases the Hydro RES of opponents hit by sword rain attacks by 15% for 4s.

sections.title: C3 · Weaver of Verses
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Evilsoother
sections.body: Throughout the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter, the DMG dealt by Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen is increased by 50%.

sections.title: C5 · Embrace of Rain
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Hence, Call Them My Own Verses
sections.body: Activating 2 of Guhua Sword: Raincutter's sword rain attacks greatly enhances the third sword rain attack. On hit, the third sword rain attack also regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu.

sections.title: Passive · Hydropathic
sections.body: When a Rain Sword is shattered or when its duration expires, it regenerates the current character's HP based on 6% of Xingqiu's Max HP.

sections.title: Passive · Blades Amidst Raindrops
sections.body: Xingqiu gains a 20% Hydro DMG Bonus.

sections.title: Passive · Flash of Genius
sections.body: When Xingqiu crafts Character Talent Materials, he has a 25% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

title: Xiao
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Lemniscatic Wind Cycling
sections.body:
Xiao lunges forward, dealing Anemo DMG to opponents in his path.
Can be used in mid-air.
Starts with 2 charges.

According to the legends of another land, the world will someday be crushed by two great wind wheels. Xiao's mastery over polearms is transcendent, ripping his foes apart like those legendary wind wheels.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Bane of All Evil
sections.body:
Xiao dons the Yaksha Mask that set gods and demons trembling millennia ago.

Yaksha's Mask
·Greatly increases Xiao's jumping ability.
·Increases his attack AoE and attack DMG.
·Converts attack DMG into Anemo DMG, which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.

In this state, Xiao will continuously lose HP.
The effects of this skill end when Xiao leaves the field.

Donning the Mask of the Yaksha, Xiao takes the terrifying, demon-conquering form of the Vigilant Yaksha. But this great power has also brought him great suffering. Some call him "The Bane of All Evil."

sections.title: C1 · Dissolution Eon: Destroyer of Worlds
sections.body: Increases Lemniscatic Wind Cycling's charges by 1.

sections.title: C2 · Annihilation Eon: Blossom of Kaleidos
sections.body: When in the party and not on the field, Xiao's Energy Recharge is increased by 25%.

sections.title: C3 · Conqueror of Evil: Wrath Deity
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Transcension: Extinction of Suffering
sections.body: When Xiao's HP falls below 50%, he gains a 100% DEF Bonus.

sections.title: C5 · Evolution Eon: Origin of Ignorance
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Bane of All Evil by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Conqueror of Evil: Guardian Yaksha
sections.body: While under the effects of Bane of All Evil, hitting at least 2 opponents with Xiao's Plunging Attack will immediately grant him 1 charge of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling, and for the next 1s, he may use Lemniscatic Wind Cycling while ignoring its CD.

sections.title: Passive · Conqueror of Evil: Tamer of Demons
sections.body:
While under the effects of Bane of All Evil, all DMG dealt by Xiao increases by 5%. DMG increases by a further 5% for every 3s the ability persists.
The maximum DMG Bonus is 25%.

sections.title: Passive · Dissolution Eon: Heaven Fall
sections.body:
Using Lemniscatic Wind Cycling increases the DMG of subsequent uses of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 15%.
This effect lasts for 7s, and has a maximum of 3 stacks. Gaining a new stack refreshes the effect's duration.

sections.title: Passive · Transcension: Gravity Defier
sections.body:
Decreases climbing Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

title: Ningguang
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Jade Screen
sections.body:
Ningguang creates a Jade Screen out of gold, obsidian, and her great opulence, dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Jade Screen
·Blocks opponents' projectiles.
·Endurance scales based on Ningguang's Max HP.

Jade Screen is considered a Geo Construct and can be used to block certain attacks, but cannot be climbed. Only one Jade Screen may exist at any one time.

The canvas of stars is written upon this jade screen.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Starshatter
sections.body:
Gathering a great number of gems, Ningguang scatters them all at once, sending homing projectiles at her opponents that deal massive Geo DMG.
If Starshatter is cast when a Jade Screen is nearby, the Jade Screen will fire additional gem projectiles at the same time.

Stars shatter. Silence falls.

sections.title: C1 · Piercing Fragments
sections.body: When a Normal Attack hits, it deals AoE DMG.

sections.title: C2 · Shock Effect
sections.body:
When Jade Screen is shattered, its CD will reset.
Can occur once every 6s.

sections.title: C3 · Majesty Be the Array of Stars
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Starshatter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Exquisite be the Jade, Outshining All Beneath
sections.body: Jade Screen increases nearby characters' Elemental RES by 10%.

sections.title: C5 · Invincible Be the Jade Screen
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Jade Screen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Grandeur Be the Seven Stars
sections.body: When Starshatter is used, Ningguang gains 7 Star Jades.

sections.title: Passive · Backup Plan
sections.body: When Ningguang is in possession of Star Jades, her Charged Attack does not consume Stamina.

sections.title: Passive · Strategic Reserve
sections.body: A character that passes through the Jade Screen will gain a 12% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Trove of Marvelous Treasures
sections.body: Displays the location of nearby ore veins used in forging on the mini-map.

title: Klee
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Jumpy Dumpty
sections.body:
Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun! 
When thrown, Jumpy Dumpty bounces thrice, igniting and dealing AoE Pyro DMG with every bounce.

On the third bounce, the bomb splits into many mines.
The mines will explode upon contact with opponents, or after a short period of time, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Starts with 2 charges.

Jumpy Dumpty is Klee's good friend! She can't help but introduce him to everyone.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Sparks 'n' Splash
sections.body:
Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

The knights all believe that Klee must have a lucky star watching over her to have never been hurt by any of her own bombs...

sections.title: C1 · Chained Reactions
sections.body: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash's DMG.

sections.title: C2 · Explosive Frags
sections.body: Being hit by Jumpy Dumpty's mines decreases opponents' DEF by 23% for 10s.

sections.title: C3 · Exquisite Compound
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Jumpy Dumpty by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Sparkly Explosion
sections.body: If Klee leaves the field during the duration of Sparks 'n' Splash, her departure triggers an explosion that deals 555% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

sections.title: C5 · Nova Burst
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Sparks 'n' Splash by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Blazing Delight
sections.body:
While under the effects of Sparks 'n' Splash, Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s.
When Sparks 'n' Splash is used, all party members will gain a 10% Pyro DMG Bonus for 25s.

sections.title: Passive · Pounding Surprise
sections.body:
When Jumpy Dumpty and Normal Attacks deal DMG, Klee has a 50% chance to obtain an Explosive Spark.
This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.

sections.title: Passive · Sparkling Burst
sections.body: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy.

sections.title: Passive · All Of My Treasures!
sections.body: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Mondstadt on the mini-map.

sections.title: Passive · Witch's Eve Rite: Sparkborne Magic
sections.body:
After completing Witch's Homework: Of Leaves That Spark, Klee will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

Hexerei: Secret Rite
When Klee deals DMG with Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts, she gains 1 Boom Badge that lasts 20s. Each type of attack can grant at most 1 Boom Badge this way, and each badge has its own independent timer. While Klee has 1/2/3 Boom Badges, her special Charged Attack Boom-Boom Strike deals 115%/130%/150% of its original DMG.

title: Zhongli
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Dominus Lapidis
sections.body:
#Every mountain, rock and inch of land is filled with the power of Geo, but those who can wield such powers freely are few and far between.

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
Commands the power of earth to create a Stone Stele.

Hold
Causes nearby Geo energy to explode, causing the following effects:
·If their maximum number hasn't been reached, creates a Stone Stele.
·Creates a shield of jade. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Zhongli's Max HP.
·Deals AoE Geo DMG.
·If there are nearby targets with the Geo element, it will drain a large amount of Geo element from a maximum of 2 such targets. This effect does not cause DMG.

Stone Stele
When created, deals AoE Geo DMG.
Additionally, it will intermittently resonate with other nearby Geo constructs, dealing Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
The Stone Stele is considered a Geo construct that can both be climbed and used to block attacks.
Only one Stele created by Zhongli himself may initially exist at any one time.

Jade Shield
Possesses 150% DMG Absorption against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
Characters protected by the Jade Shield will decrease the Elemental RES and Physical RES of opponents in a small AoE by 20%. This effect cannot be stacked.

A true master of stone may carve jade and shape gold.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Planet Befall
sections.body:
Brings a falling meteor down to earth, dealing massive Geo DMG to opponents caught in its AoE and applying the Petrification status to them.

Petrification
Opponents affected by the Petrification status cannot move.

The falling meteor punishes the unjust.

sections.title: C1 · Rock, the Backbone of Earth
sections.body: Increases the maximum number of Stone Steles created by Dominus Lapidis that may exist simultaneously to 2.

sections.title: C2 · Stone, the Cradle of Jade
sections.body: Planet Befall grants nearby characters on the field a Jade Shield when it descends.

sections.title: C3 · Jade, Shimmering through Darkness
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Dominus Lapidis by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Topaz, Unbreakable and Fearless
sections.body: Increases Planet Befall's AoE by 20% and increases the duration of Planet Befall's Petrification effect by 2s.

sections.title: C5 · Lazuli, Herald of the Order
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Planet Befall by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Chrysos, Bounty of Dominator
sections.body:
When the Jade Shield takes DMG, 40% of that incoming DMG is converted to HP for the current character.
A single instance of regeneration cannot exceed 8% of that character's Max HP.

sections.title: Passive · Resonant Waves
sections.body:
When the Jade Shield takes DMG, it will Fortify:
·Fortified characters have 5% increased Shield Strength.
Can stack up to 5 times, and lasts until the Jade Shield disappears.

sections.title: Passive · Dominance of Earth
sections.body:
Zhongli deals bonus DMG based on his Max HP:
·Normal Attack, Charged Attack, and Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 1.39% of Max HP.
·Dominus Lapidis' Stone Stele, resonance, and hold DMG is increased by 1.9% of Max HP.
·Planet Befall's DMG is increased by 33% of Max HP.

sections.title: Passive · Arcanum of Crystal
sections.body: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Polearm-type weapons.

title: Fischl
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Nightrider
sections.body:
#Summons Oz. The night raven forged of darkness and lightning descends upon the land, dealing Electro DMG in a small AoE.
For the ability's duration, Oz will continuously attack nearby opponents with Freikugel.

Hold to adjust the location Oz will be summoned to.
{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press} again any time during the ability's duration to once again summon him to Fischl's side.

"My time is most precious, and I shall not waste it on the likes of you... Go, Oz, fall upon them, and bring down upon them your Rachsüchtig Blitz, that which tears open the long night."
—Flowers for Princess Fischl (IV): Farewell Frau Welt

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Midnight Phantasmagoria
sections.body:
Summons Oz to spread his twin wings of twilight and defend Fischl.
Has the following properties during the ability's duration:
·Fischl takes on Oz's form, greatly increasing her Movement Speed.
·Strikes nearby opponents with lightning, dealing Electro DMG to opponents she comes into contact with. Each opponent can only be struck once.
·Once this ability's effects end, Oz will remain on the battlefield and attack his Prinzessin's foes. If Oz is already on the field, then this will reset the duration of his presence.

"...In the hordes of beasts that follow the cursed blood, only Prince Nachtraben, who bore witness to the extinction of a thousand worlds, knows her true greatness. Thus the night wings he spreads are his eternal promise to protect Her Royal Highness."
—Flowers for Princess Fischl (I): End Time Zersetzung

sections.title: C1 · Gaze of the Deep
sections.body: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.

sections.title: C2 · Devourer of All Sins
sections.body: When Nightrider is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.

sections.title: C3 · Wings of Nightmare
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Nightrider by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
sections.body:
When Midnight Phantasmagoria is used, it deals 222% of ATK as Electro DMG to surrounding opponents.
When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

sections.title: C5 · Against the Fleeing Light
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Midnight Phantasmagoria by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Evernight Raven
sections.body: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as Electro DMG.

sections.title: Passive · Stellar Predator
sections.body: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.

sections.title: Passive · Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex
sections.body: If your current active character triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals Electro DMG equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.

sections.title: Passive · Mein Hausgarten
sections.body: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

sections.title: Passive · Witch's Eve Rite: Phantasmal Nocturne
sections.body:
After completing Witch's Homework: Of the Unexpected, Fischl will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

Hexerei: Secret Rite
Hark, Prince Nachtraben, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, he who has witnessed the fall of countless worlds. Sing now the starry septet for your sovereign, for this is the moment of deepest sin, when the gathered souls at the end of causality shatter the darkness of fate.
Additionally, when Oz is on the field, party members will gain additional buff effects:
· After a nearby party member triggers an Overloaded reaction, Fischl and other nearby active party members have their ATK increased by 22.5% for 10s.
· After a nearby party member triggers an Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reaction, Fischl and other nearby active party members have their Elemental Mastery increased by 90 for 10s.

title: Bennett
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Passion Overload
sections.body:
#Bennett puts all his fire and passion for adventuring into his sword. Results may vary based on how fired up he is...

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
A single, swift flame strike that deals Pyro DMG.

Hold (Short)
Charges up, resulting in different effects when unleashed based on the Charge Level.
·Level 1: Strikes twice, dealing Pyro DMG and launching opponents.
·Level 2: Unleashes 3 consecutive attacks that deal impressive Pyro DMG, but the last attack triggers an explosion that launches both Bennett and the enemy.
Bennett takes no damage from being launched.

An attack that combines Bennett's dreams and passion with Pyro. But passion is sometimes overblown, and Pyro sometimes blows over.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Fantastic Voyage
sections.body:
Bennett performs a jumping attack that deals Pyro DMG, creating an Inspiration Field.

Inspiration Field
·If the health of a character within the AoE is equal to or falls below 70%, their health will continuously regenerate. The amount of HP restored scales off Bennett's Max HP.
·If the health of a character within the AoE is higher than 70%, they gain an ATK Bonus that is based on Bennett's Base ATK.
·Imbues characters within the AoE with Pyro.

Benny's Adventure Team's adventures are always fraught with unexpected danger. However, Bennett is more inclined to call them "journeys full of wonder, excitement, and beauty."

sections.title: C1 · Grand Expectation
sections.body: Fantastic Voyage's ATK increase no longer has an HP restriction, and gains an additional 20% of Bennett's Base ATK.

sections.title: C2 · Impasse Conqueror
sections.body: When Bennett's HP falls below 70%, his Energy Recharge is increased by 30%.

sections.title: C3 · Unstoppable Fervor
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Passion Overload by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Unexpected Odyssey
sections.body:
Using a Normal Attack as the second attack of Passion Overload's Charge Level 1 will perform a follow-up attack.
This additional attack does 135% of the second attack's DMG.

sections.title: C5 · True Explorer
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Fantastic Voyage by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Fire Ventures With Me
sections.body: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters inside Fantastic Voyage's radius gain a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus and their weapons are infused with Pyro.

sections.title: Passive · Rekindle
sections.body: Decreases Passion Overload's CD by 20%.

sections.title: Passive · Fearnaught
sections.body:
Within the area created by Fantastic Voyage, Passion Overload takes on the following effects:
·CD is reduced by 50%.
·Bennett will not be launched by the effects of Charge Level 2.

sections.title: Passive · It Should Be Safe...
sections.body: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

title: Tartaglia
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Foul Legacy: Raging Tide
sections.body:
Unleashes a set of weaponry made of pure water, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and entering Melee Stance.
In this Stance, Tartaglia's Normal and Charged Attacks are converted to Hydro DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion and change as follows:

Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive Hydro strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a cross slash, dealing Hydro DMG.

Riptide Slash
Hitting an opponent affected by Riptide with a melee attack unleashes a Riptide Slash that deals AoE Hydro DMG. DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG, and can only occur once every 1.5s.

After 30s, or when the ability is unleashed again, this skill will end. Tartaglia will return to his Ranged Stance and this ability will enter CD. The longer Tartaglia stays in his Melee Stance, the longer the CD.
If the return to a ranged stance occurs automatically after 30s, the CD is even longer.

He chose the bow as his weapon precisely to overcome his weakness with it. But a serious fight demands that he gets serious...

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Havoc: Obliteration
sections.body:
Performs different attacks based on what stance Tartaglia is in when casting.

Ranged Stance: Flash of Havoc
Swiftly fires a Hydro-imbued magic arrow, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and applying the Riptide status.
Returns a portion of its Energy Cost after use.

Melee Stance: Light of Obliteration
Performs a slash with a large AoE, dealing massive Hydro DMG to all surrounding opponents, which triggers Riptide Blast.

Riptide Blast
When the obliterating waters hit an opponent affected by Riptide, it clears their Riptide status and triggers a Hydro Explosion that deals AoE Hydro DMG.
DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

Rushing waters are rarely seen in his snowy homeland. Perhaps his ability to command water is due to his understanding of just how precious it is.

sections.title: C1 · Foul Legacy: Tide Withholder
sections.body: Decreases the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 20%.

sections.title: C2 · Foul Legacy: Understream
sections.body: When opponents affected by Riptide are defeated, Tartaglia regenerates 4 Elemental Energy.

sections.title: C3 · Abyssal Mayhem: Vortex of Turmoil
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Abyssal Mayhem: Hydrospout
sections.body:
If Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, triggers Riptide Slash against opponents on the field affected by Riptide every 4s, otherwise, triggers Riptide Flash.
Riptide Slashes and Riptide Flashes triggered by this Constellation effect are not subject to the time intervals that would typically apply to these two Riptide effects, nor do they have any effect on those time intervals.

sections.title: C5 · Havoc: Formless Blade
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Havoc: Obliteration by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Havoc: Annihilation
sections.body:
When Havoc: Obliteration is cast in Melee Stance, the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide is reset.
This effect will only take place once Tartaglia returns to his Ranged Stance.

sections.title: Passive · Never Ending
sections.body: Extends Riptide duration by 8s.

sections.title: Passive · Sword of Torrents
sections.body: When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, on dealing a CRIT hit, Normal and Charged Attacks apply the Riptide status effect to opponents.

sections.title: Passive · Master of Weaponry
sections.body: Increases your own party members' Normal Attack Level by 1.

title: Noelle
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Breastplate
sections.body:
Summons protective stone armor, dealing Geo DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a shield. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Noelle's DEF.
The shield has the following properties:
·When Noelle's Normal and Charged Attacks hit a target, they have a certain chance to regenerate HP for all characters.
·Possesses 150% DMG Absorption efficiency against all Elemental and Physical DMG.

The amount of HP healed when regeneration is triggered scales based on Noelle's DEF.

Noelle is both a dutiful maid and a valiant knight.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Sweeping Time
sections.body:
Gathering the strength of stone around her weapon, Noelle strikes the opponents surrounding her within a large AoE, dealing Geo DMG.
Afterwards, Noelle gains the following effects:
·Larger attack AoE.
·Converts attack DMG to Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Increased ATK that scales based on her DEF.

Sometimes, it's not just dust that needs sweeping...

sections.title: C1 · I Got Your Back
sections.body: While Sweeping Time and Breastplate are both in effect, the chance of Breastplate's healing effects activating is increased to 100%.

sections.title: C2 · Combat Maid
sections.body: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Noelle's Charged Attacks by 20% and increases her Charged Attack DMG by 15%.

sections.title: C3 · Invulnerable Maid
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Breastplate by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · To Be Cleaned
sections.body: When Breastplate's duration expires or it is destroyed by DMG, it will deal 400% of Noelle's ATK as Geo DMG to surrounding opponents.

sections.title: C5 · Favonius Sweeper Master
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Sweeping Time by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Must Be Spotless
sections.body:
Sweeping Time increases Noelle's ATK by an additional 50% of her DEF.
Additionally, every opponent defeated during the skill's duration adds 1s to the duration, up to 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Devotion
sections.body:
When Noelle is in the party but not on the field, this ability triggers automatically when your active character's HP falls below 30%:
Creates a shield for your active character that lasts for 20s and absorbs DMG equal to 400% of Noelle's DEF.
The shield has a 150% DMG Absorption effectiveness against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
This effect can only occur once every 60s.

sections.title: Passive · Nice and Clean
sections.body:
Noelle will decrease the CD of Breastplate by 1s for every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores on opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.

sections.title: Passive · Maid's Knighthood
sections.body: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a DEF-boosting dish, Noelle has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

title: Qiqi
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost
sections.body:
Using the Icevein Talisman, Qiqi brings forth the Herald of Frost, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.

Herald of Frost
·On hit, Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attacks regenerate HP for your own party members and nearby teammates. Healing scales based on Qiqi's ATK.
·Periodically regenerates your active character's HP.
·Follows the character around, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in their path.

I use this to prevent warming and rot... of Dr. Bai's precious ingredients. Yes.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune
sections.body:
Qiqi releases the adeptus power sealed within her body, marking nearby opponents with a Fortune-Preserving Talisman that deals Cryo DMG.

Fortune-Preserving Talisman
When opponents affected by this Talisman take DMG, the character that dealt this DMG regenerates HP.

"I am the Fortune Preserver, the Maiden of Resurrection."
— Qiqi does not remember these words.

sections.title: C1 · Ascetics of Frost
sections.body: When the Herald of Frost hits an opponent marked by a Fortune-Preserving Talisman, Qiqi regenerates 2 Energy.

sections.title: C2 · Frozen to the Bone
sections.body: Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attack DMG against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

sections.title: C3 · Ascendant Praise
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Divine Suppression
sections.body: Targets marked by the Fortune-Preserving Talisman have their ATK decreased by 20%.

sections.title: C5 · Crimson Lotus Bloom
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Rite of Resurrection
sections.body:
Using Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune revives all fallen party members nearby and regenerates 50% of their HP.
This effect can only occur once every 15 mins.

sections.title: Passive · Life-Prolonging Methods
sections.body: When a character under the effects of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost triggers an Elemental Reaction, their Incoming Healing Bonus is increased by 20% for 8s.

sections.title: Passive · A Glimpse Into Arcanum
sections.body: When Qiqi hits opponents with her Normal and Charged Attacks, she has a 50% chance to apply a Fortune-Preserving Talisman to them for 6s. This effect can only occur once every 30s.

sections.title: Passive · Former Life Memories
sections.body: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Liyue on the mini-map.

sections.title: Passive · Seven Sacred Treasures
sections.body:
The cooldown of the Elemental Skill Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost is reduced to 15s.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: While the Herald of Frost is on the field, Qiqi's own party members will have the DMG they deal via the corresponding reactions enhanced:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Superconduct and Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG is increased by 50%.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Cryo Swirl and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt is increased by 50%.
Additionally, Qiqi will also enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party character triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.

title: Chongyun
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost
sections.body:
Chongyun strikes the ground with his greatsword, causing a Cryo explosion in a circular AoE in front of him that deals Cryo DMG.
After a short delay, the cold air created by the Cryo explosion will coalesce into a Chonghua Frost Field, within which all Sword, Claymore and Polearm-wielding characters' weapons will be infused with Cryo.

"A crystal-clear ring, and all is silent. The rivers move not, and the clouds are heavy with frost. The altar gates open, and evil is banished."

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star
sections.body:
Performing the secret hand seals, Chongyun summons 3 giant spirit blades in mid-air that fall to the earth one by one after a short delay, exploding as they hit the ground.
When the spirit blades explode, they will deal AoE Cryo DMG and launch opponents.

"As ice doth give the biting frost birth, My transcendent blade shakes heaven and earth. Heed my summons and come hence!"

sections.title: C1 · Ice Unleashed
sections.body: The last attack of Chongyun's Normal Attack combo releases 3 ice blades. Each blade deals 50% of Chongyun's ATK as Cryo DMG to all opponents in its path.

sections.title: C2 · Atmospheric Revolution
sections.body: Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts cast within the Frost Field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their CD time decreased by 15%.

sections.title: C3 · Cloudburst
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Frozen Skies
sections.body:
Chongyun regenerates 1 Energy every time he hits an opponent affected by Cryo.
This effect can only occur once every 2s.

sections.title: C5 · The True Path
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Rally of Four Blades
sections.body:
Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star deals 15% more DMG to opponents with a lower percentage of their Max HP remaining than Chongyun.
This skill will also summon 1 additional spirit blade.

sections.title: Passive · Steady Breathing
sections.body: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters within the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 8%.

sections.title: Passive · Rimechaser Blade
sections.body: When the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost disappears, another spirit blade will be summoned to strike nearby opponents, dealing 100% of Chonghua's Layered Frost's Skill DMG as AoE Cryo DMG. Opponents hit by this blade will have their Cryo RES decreased by 10% for 8s.

sections.title: Passive · Gallant Journey
sections.body: When dispatched on an expedition in Liyue, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

title: Ganyu
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Trail of the Qilin
sections.body:
Leaving a single Ice Lotus behind, Ganyu dashes backward, shunning all impurity and dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Ice Lotus
·Continuously taunts surrounding opponents, attracting them to attack it.
·Endurance scales based on Ganyu's Max HP.
·Blooms profusely when destroyed or once its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

"You saw me, you say? You must be mistaken. I was working overtime then."

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Celestial Shower
sections.body:
Coalesces atmospheric frost and snow to summon a Sacred Cryo Pearl that exorcises evil.
During its ability duration, the Sacred Cryo Pearl will continuously rain down shards of ice, striking opponents within an AoE and dealing Cryo DMG.

Ganyu can bring down sweet rains as a matter of course. But against demons and heretics, they become bitter, freezing snow.

sections.title: C1 · Dew-Drinker
sections.body:
Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrows or Frostflake Arrow Blooms decrease opponents' Cryo RES by 15% for 6s upon hit.
A hit also regenerates 2 Energy for Ganyu. This effect can only occur once per Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrow, regardless if Frostflake Arrow itself or its Bloom hits the target.

sections.title: C2 · The Auspicious
sections.body: Trail of the Qilin gains 1 additional charge.

sections.title: C3 · Cloud-Strider
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Celestial Shower by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Westward Sojourn
sections.body:
Opponents standing within the AoE of Celestial Shower take increased DMG. This effect strengthens over time.
Increased DMG taken begins at 5% and increases by 5% every 3s, up to a maximum of 25%.
The effect lingers for 3s after the opponent leaves the AoE.

sections.title: C5 · The Merciful
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Trail of the Qilin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · The Clement
sections.body: Using Trail of the Qilin causes the next Frostflake Arrow shot within 30s to not require charging.

sections.title: Passive · Undivided Heart
sections.body: After firing a Frostflake Arrow, the CRIT Rate of subsequent Frostflake Arrows and their resulting bloom effects is increased by 20% for 5s.

sections.title: Passive · Harmony Between Heaven and Earth
sections.body: Celestial Shower grants a 20% Cryo DMG Bonus to active party members in the AoE.

sections.title: Passive · Preserved for the Hunt
sections.body: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Bow-type weapons.

title: Albedo
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma
sections.body:
Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma using alchemy, which deals AoE Geo DMG on appearance.

Solar Isotoma
has the following properties:
·When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal AoE Geo DMG. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF. 
·Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.
·When a character is located at the locus of the Solar Isotoma, the Solar Isotoma will accumulate Geo power to form a crystallized platform that lifts the character up to a certain height. Only one crystallized platform can exist at a time.
·Solar Isotoma is considered a Geo construct. Only one Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself can exist at a time. 

Hold to designate the location of the skill.

This Geo bloom has an unusual property mirrored in the aim of alchemy. To rise from the earth, soar into the sky, and become the sun.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide
sections.body:
Under Albedo's command, Geo crystals surge and burst forth, dealing AoE Geo DMG in front of him.
If a Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself is on the field, 7 Fatal Blossoms will be generated in the Solar Isotoma field, bursting violently into bloom and dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Tectonic Tide DMG and Fatal Blossom DMG will not generate Transient Blossoms.

Under the Kreideprinz's command, the tectonic tide of creation seethes into life.

sections.title: C1 · Flower of Eden
sections.body: Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.

sections.title: C2 · Opening of Phanerozoic
sections.body:
Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
·Unleashing Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF.
·This effect stacks up to 4 times.

sections.title: C3 · Grace of Helios
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Descent of Divinity
sections.body: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.

sections.title: C5 · Tide of Hadean
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Dust of Purification
sections.body: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a shield created by Crystallize, or when Moondrifts are present within the Solar Isotoma field, have their DMG increased by 17%.

sections.title: Passive · Calcite Might
sections.body: Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma deal 25% more DMG to opponents whose HP is below 50%.

sections.title: Passive · Homuncular Nature
sections.body: Using Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide increases the Elemental Mastery of nearby party members by 125 for 10s.

sections.title: Passive · Flash of Genius
sections.body: When Albedo crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

sections.title: Passive · Witch's Eve Rite: Book of Blinding Light
sections.body:
After completing Witch's Homework: Beyond the Lesson, Albedo will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

Hexerei: Secret Rite
· When Albedo hits an opponent with his Elemental Skill within 20s of using an Elemental Skill, it will generate a Silver Isotoma near the opponent that lasts for 10s. When there are no Solar Isotomas created by Albedo on the field, and as long as Albedo is not downed, a single Silver Isotoma will begin generating Transient Blossoms, just as Solar Isotomas would. There can be up to two Silver Isotomas generated by Albedo on the field at any one time.
· After creating a Solar Isotoma, nearby party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 4% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has for 20s. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 12%.
· After generating a Silver Isotoma, nearby Hexerei party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 10% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has for 20s. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 30%.

title: Diona
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Icy Paws
sections.body:
#Fires an Icy Paw that deals Cryo DMG to opponents and forms a shield on hit.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target.

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws.

Hold
Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws.
The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus.

The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration.

When she first started bartending, Diona found that no matter how much ice she put in her cocktails, it would never do a drunkard any harm. That all changed when she received her Vision — now she can form ice cold enough to cause severe brainfreeze. Five out of five stars!

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Signature Mix
sections.body:
Tosses out a special cold brew that deals AoE Cryo DMG and creates a Drunken Mist in an AoE.

Drunken Mist
·Deals continuous Cryo DMG to opponents within the AoE.
·Continuously regenerates the HP of characters within the AoE.

A horrific mix that even Diona considers inhumane. The horrifying foretaste should be left for one's opponents. It has a crisp aftertaste, but unfortunately, one can only feel it on one's nose and skin.

sections.title: C1 · A Lingering Flavor
sections.body: Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of Signature Mix end.

sections.title: C2 · Shaken, Not Purred
sections.body:
Increases Icy Paws' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%.
Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the Icy Paws shield's DMG Absorption for 5s.

sections.title: C3 · A—Another Round?
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Signature Mix by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Wine Industry Slayer
sections.body: Within the radius of Signature Mix, Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60%

sections.title: C5 · Double Shot, on the Rocks
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Icy Paws by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Cat's Tail Closing Time
sections.body:
Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts:
·Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%.
·Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.

sections.title: Passive · Cat's Tail Secret Menu
sections.body: Characters shielded by Icy Paws have their Movement SPD increased by 10% and their Stamina Consumption decreased by 10%.

sections.title: Passive · Drunkards' Farce
sections.body: Opponents who enter the AoE of Signature Mix have 10% decreased ATK for 15s.

sections.title: Passive · Complimentary Bar Food
sections.body: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

sections.title: Passive · Choice Treasures
sections.body:
Within 20s after using the Elemental Skill Icy Paws, Diona will also fire off three Icy Paws when party members trigger Stellar-Conduct, Superconduct, Cryo Swirl, or Stellar Swirl reactions. Icy Paws fired this way cannot generate Elemental Particles, nor will they generate a shield upon hitting opponents. This effect can occur once every 3.5s.
Additionally, Diona will also enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.

title: Mona
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Mirror Reflection of Doom
sections.body:
Creates an illusory Phantom of Fate from coalesced waterspouts.

Phantom
Has the following special properties:
·Continuously taunts nearby opponents, attracting their fire.
·Continuously deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
·When its duration expires, the Phantom explodes, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Hold
Utilizes water currents to move backwards swiftly before conjuring a Phantom.

Only one Phantom created by Mirror Reflection of Doom can exist at any time.

Skilled astrologers have always dreamed of using a phantom facsimile of themselves to ward off imminent ill fate, but Mona must be the first to make such a mockery of it in all of Teyvat.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Illusory Torrent
sections.body:
Alternate Sprint
Mona cloaks herself within the water's flow, consuming Stamina to move rapidly.

When under the effect of Illusory Torrent, Mona can move at high speed on water.
Applies the Wet status to nearby opponents when she reappears.

This is something that Mona can do, but her teacher cannot. Well, but it's not as if her teacher would pursue any matter concerning Hydro Visions anyway...

sections.title: C1 · Prophecy of Submersion
sections.body:
When any of your own party members hits an opponent affected by an Omen, the effects of Hydro-related Elemental Reactions are enhanced for 8s:
· Electro-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Vaporize DMG increases by 15%, Hydro Swirl DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Crystallize DMG increases by 15%.
· Frozen duration is extended by 15%.

sections.title: C2 · Lunar Chain
sections.body:
When a Normal Attack hits, there is a 20% chance that it will be automatically followed by a Charged Attack.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

sections.title: C3 · Restless Revolution
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Stellaris Phantasm by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Prophecy of Oblivion
sections.body: When any party member attacks an opponent affected by an Omen, their CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

sections.title: C5 · Mockery of Fortuna
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Mirror Reflection of Doom by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Rhetorics of Calamitas
sections.body:
Upon entering Illusory Torrent, Mona gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second of movement.
A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.

sections.title: Passive · "Come 'n' Get Me, Hag!"
sections.body:
After she has used Illusory Torrent for 2s, if there are any opponents nearby, Mona will automatically create a Phantom.
A Phantom created in this manner lasts for 2s, and its explosion DMG is equal to 50% of Mirror Reflection of Doom.

sections.title: Passive · Waterborne Destiny
sections.body: Increases Mona's Hydro DMG Bonus by a degree equivalent to 20% of her Energy Recharge rate.

sections.title: Passive · Principium of Astrology
sections.body: When Mona crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 25% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

sections.title: Passive · Witch's Eve Rite: Genesis of Starsigns
