Additionally, when a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, the Traveler will regain 4 Energy.

sections.title: Passive · Foreign Starfire
sections.body:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs.

Additionally, when nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Burst, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of the Sacred Flame, max 2 stacks. After obtaining 2 stacks of Blade of the Sacred Flame, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of the Sacred Flame and transform into a special Charged Attack: Inferno.

Charged Attack: Inferno
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased, Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 200% of Traveler's ATK.
· Charged Attack: Inferno can be triggered up to once every 15s.

title: Traveler · Aquacrest Saber
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Aquacrest Saber
sections.body:
Unleashes a torrent that can cleanse the world.

Press
Sends a Torrent Surge forward that will deal Hydro DMG to opponents it comes into contact with.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode and constantly fire off Dewdrops in the direction in which you are aiming, dealing Hydro DMG to opponents they hit.
When the skill ends, it will send a Torrent Surge forward that will deal Hydro DMG to opponents it comes into contact with.
Suffusion: When using the Hold configuration of this skill, if the Traveler's HP is higher than 50%, the DMG dealt by Dewdrops will increase based on the Traveler's Max HP, and the Traveler will lose a fixed amount of HP every second.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, after using Torrent Surge, this skill will unleash a Spiritbreath Thorn that pierces opponents, dealing Pneuma-aligned Hydro DMG.

You studied the ripples in the water with Paimon.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Rising Waters
sections.body:
Unleashes a slow-moving floating bubble that deals continuous Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.

You studied the ebb and flow of the tides with Paimon.

sections.title: C1 · Swelling Lake
sections.body:
Picking up a Sourcewater Droplet will restore 2 Energy to the Traveler.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Spotless Waters."

sections.title: C2 · Trickling Purity
sections.body: The Movement SPD of Rising Waters' bubble will be decreased by 30%, and its duration increased by 3s.

sections.title: C3 · Turbulent Ripples
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Aquacrest Saber by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Pouring Descent
sections.body:
When using Aquacrest Saber, an Aquacrest Aegis that can absorb 10% of the Traveler's Max HP in DMG will be created and will absorb Hydro DMG with 250% effectiveness. It will persist until the Traveler finishes using the skill.
Once every 2s, after a Dewdrop hits an opponent, if the Traveler is being protected by Aquacrest Aegis, the DMG Absorption of the Aegis will be restored to 10% of the Traveler's Max HP. If the Traveler is not presently being protected by an Aegis, one will be redeployed.

sections.title: C5 · Churning Whirlpool
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Rising Waters by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Tides of Justice
sections.body: When the Traveler picks up a Sourcewater Droplet, they will restore HP to a nearby party member with the lowest remaining HP percentage based on 6% of said member's Max HP.

sections.title: Passive · Spotless Waters
sections.body:
After the Dewdrop fired by the Hold Mode of the Aquacrest Saber hits an opponent, a Sourcewater Droplet will be generated near to the Traveler. If the Traveler picks it up, they will restore 7% HP.
1 Droplet can be created this way every second, and each use of Aquacrest Saber can create 4 Droplets at most.

sections.title: Passive · Clear Waters
sections.body:
If HP has been consumed via Suffusion while using the Hold Mode Aquacrest Saber, the Torrent Surge at the skill's end will deal Bonus DMG equal to 45% of the total HP the Traveler has consumed in this skill use via Suffusion.
The maximum DMG Bonus that can be gained this way is 5,000.

sections.title: Passive · Foreign Aqualis
sections.body:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs.

Additionally, when nearby party members' current HP increases or decreases by 5%, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Many Waters. You can gain 1 stack of Blade of Many Waters this way once every 4s, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Many Waters, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Many Waters and transform into the special Charged Attack: Tidebound.

Charged Attack: Tidebound
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Hydro DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 150% of Traveler's ATK,
· When Traveler's HP is no less than 50%, 10% of Traveler's Max HP will be consumed to increase DMG inflicted by each Charged Attack hit by 100% of Traveler's ATK.
· When Traveler's HP is lower than 50%, one instance of healing equal to 25% of Traveler's Max HP will be restored upon hitting an enemy.
· Charged Attack: Tidebound can be triggered up to once every 15s.

title: Traveler · Palm Vortex
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Palm Vortex
sections.body:
Grasping the wind's might, you form a vortex of vacuum in your palm, causing continuous Anemo DMG to opponents in front of you.
The vacuum vortex explodes when the skill duration ends, causing a greater amount of Anemo DMG over a larger area.

Hold
DMG and AoE will gradually increase.

Elemental Absorption
If the vortex comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

You discussed the way to grasp the formless wind with Paimon.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Gust Surge
sections.body:
Guiding the path of the wind currents, you summon a forward-moving tornado that pulls objects and opponents towards itself, dealing continuous Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the tornado comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

You and Paimon studied the flapping of a butterfly's wings.

sections.title: C1 · Raging Vortex
sections.body: Palm Vortex pulls in opponents and objects within a 5m radius.

sections.title: C2 · Uprising Whirlwind
sections.body: Increases Energy Recharge by 16%.

sections.title: C3 · Sweeping Gust
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Gust Surge by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Cherishing Breezes
sections.body: Reduces DMG taken while casting Palm Vortex by 10%.

sections.title: C5 · Vortex Stellaris
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Palm Vortex by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Intertwined Winds
sections.body:
Targets who take DMG from Gust Surge have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

sections.title: Passive · Slitting Wind
sections.body: The last hit of a Normal Attack combo unleashes a wind blade, dealing 60% of ATK as Anemo DMG to all opponents in its path.

sections.title: Passive · Second Wind
sections.body:
Palm Vortex kills regenerate 2% HP for 5s.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

sections.title: Passive · Foreign Windwrath
sections.body:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs.

Additionally, when Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro attacks from nearby party members hit opponents, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of the Dawn Breeze. Each Elemental Type can grant 1 Blade of the Dawn Breeze stack. After obtaining at least 2 stacks of Blade of the Dawn Breeze, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of the Dawn Breeze and transform into the special Charged Attack: Whirlwind.

Charged Attack: Whirlwind
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Anemo DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 60% of Traveler's ATK.
· Every time a Blade of the Dawn Breeze of a certain elemental type is consumed, a Blade Wind matching this elemental type will also be summoned, dealing elemental DMG equal to 50% of Traveler's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· Charged Attack: Whirlwind can be triggered up to once every 15s.
· For the duration of Charged Attack: Whirlwind, no Blade of the Dawn Breeze will be obtained.

title: Traveler · Ice Fog Piercer
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Ice Fog Piercer
sections.body:
Stabs at the opponent with the Traveler's weapon, which releases an ice-cold fog. This deals Cryo DMG to opponents up ahead and forms a Frostpierce Star next to the Traveler.

Frostpierce Star
· Follows your own party members around the field and periodically fires ice crystals at nearby opponents, dealing Cryo DMG.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Frostpierce Star will no longer fire ice crystals at opponents at intervals but will instead fire an ice crystal at opponents in a coordinated attack when the Traveler hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
· When an opponent is hit with an ice crystal, the Traveler gains 1 stack of Frostglow (max 8 stacks).
· When not in combat, Frostglow expires after 30s.

You observed the formation of frost together with Paimon.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Frostbound Javelin
sections.body:
Generates an ice javelin with the power of Cryo, then directs it at enemies to deal multiple instances of Cryo DMG.
When cast, the Traveler consumes all existing stacks of Frostglow, which in turn increases the DMG dealt by this Elemental Burst. When 8 stacks of Frostglow are consumed, the number of DMG instances caused by the javelins is also increased.

Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: DMG from the current Elemental Burst is changed to Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.

You felt the keen edge of the icicles alongside Paimon.

sections.title: C1 · Somber Freeze
sections.body: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

sections.title: C2 · Frostfall Reverberation
sections.body:
The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an ice crystal fired by the Elemental Skill Ice Fog Piercer.
Additionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.

sections.title: C3 · Glacial Shard
sections.body:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst Frostbound Javelin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Enduring Ice
sections.body: The duration of the Frostpierce Star created by the Elemental Skill Ice Fog Piercer is increased by 25%.

sections.title: C5 · Bittercold Fog
sections.body:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Ice Fog Piercer by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Brumal Grimfrost
sections.body: Every stack of Frostglow consumed when using the Elemental Burst Frostbound Javelin increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.

sections.title: Passive · Ever-Keen Frost
sections.body: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: When a Frostpierce Star is on the field, DMG from the Traveler's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to Cryo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion, and DMG dealt is also increased by 80% of the Traveler's ATK.

sections.title: Passive · Lucent Ice
sections.body: The Traveler's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of their ATK. Up to 160 Elemental Mastery can be gained in this way.

sections.title: Passive · Stellar Jubilee: Illusory Frostmirror
sections.body:
The Traveler will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.35% for every 100 points of the Traveler's ATK. A maximum 7% increase can be obtained in this way.

sections.title: Passive · Foreign Permafrost
sections.body:
Draws new strength and power from their past travels: Every Elemental Type the Traveler has resonated with now grants an additional enhancement effect.

Additionally, when a nearby party member deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG, the Traveler gains 1 stack of "Icepoint." 1 stack of Icepoint can be obtained in this way once every 2s, max 3 stacks. When the Traveler unleashes a Charged Attack at 3 stacks of Icepoint, all stacks are consumed to change the attack into a special Charged Attack: Freezing Ice.

Charged Attack: Freezing Ice
· Cryo DMG dealt is increased by 140% of the Traveler's ATK, and the Traveler also gains 2 stacks of Frostglow.
· Charged Attack: Freezing Ice can be unleashed once every 15s. Additionally, the DMG Bonus from the Ascension Talent "Ever-Keen Frost" does not apply to Charged Attack: Freezing Ice.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: DMG from Charged Attack: Freezing Ice is instead considered Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.

title: Traveler · Starfell Sword
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Starfell Sword
sections.body:
You disgorge a meteorite from the depths of the earth, dealing AoE Geo DMG.
The meteorite is considered a Geo Construct, and can be climbed or used to block attacks.

Hold
This skill's positioning may be adjusted.

You spoke with Paimon about the final destination of falling stars.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Wake of Earth
sections.body:
Energizing the Geo deep underground, you set off expanding shockwaves.
Launches surrounding opponents back and deals AoE Geo DMG.
A stone wall is erected at the edges of the shockwave.
The stone wall is considered a Geo Construct, and may be used to block attacks.

You and Paimon studied the pulse of the mountains.

sections.title: C1 · Invincible Stonewall
sections.body: Party members within the radius of Wake of Earth have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

sections.title: C2 · Rockcore Meltdown
sections.body: When the meteorite created by Starfell Sword is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional AoE Geo DMG equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword.

sections.title: C3 · Will of the Rock
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Wake of Earth by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Reaction Force
sections.body:
The shockwave triggered by Wake of Earth regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit.
A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

sections.title: C5 · Meteorite Impact
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Starfell Sword by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Everlasting Boulder
sections.body:
The barrier created by Wake of Earth lasts 5s longer.
The meteorite created by Starfell Sword lasts 10s longer.

sections.title: Passive · Shattered Darkrock
sections.body: Reduces Starfell Sword's CD by 2s.

sections.title: Passive · Frenzied Rockslide
sections.body: The final hit of a Normal Attack combo triggers a collapse, dealing 60% of ATK as AoE Geo DMG.

sections.title: Passive · Foreign Adamantine
sections.body:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs.

Additionally, when nearby party members become protected by a shield, when the shield is replaced for any reason, or when Geo Constructs are created, the Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Archaic Petra, max 3 stacks. Up to 1 stack may be obtained every second in this way. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra and transform into the special Charged Attack: Rockfell.

Charged Attack: Rockfell
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Geo DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 120% of Traveler's ATK.
· For 15s after hitting an opponent, nearby party members will have their shield strength temporarily increased by 20%.
· Charged Attack: Rockfell can be triggered up to once every 15s.

title: Traveler · Lightning Blade
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Lightning Blade
sections.body:
Unleashes three swift thunder shadows that deal Electro DMG to opponents and leave an Abundance Amulet behind after hitting an opponent.
2 Abundance Amulets can be created initially. Using this skill will reset any Abundance Amulets that were generated.

Abundance Amulets
When a character is near an Abundance Amulet, they will absorb it and obtain the following effects:
·Restores Elemental Energy
·Increases Energy Recharge during the Abundance Amulet's duration.

You and Paimon discuss the paths by which electricity might flow.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Bellowing Thunder
sections.body:
You call upon the protection of lightning, knocking nearby opponents back and dealing Electro DMG to them.

Lightning Shroud
When your active character's Normal or Charged Attacks hit opponents, they will call Falling Thunder forth, dealing Electro DMG.
When Falling Thunder hits opponents, it will regenerate Energy for that character.
One instance of Falling Thunder can be generated every 0.5s.

You and Paimon studied the light that flashes through the clouds.

sections.title: C1 · Spring Thunder of Fertility
sections.body: The number of Abundance Amulets that can be generated using Lightning Blade is increased to 3.

sections.title: C2 · Violet Vehemence
sections.body: When Falling Thunder created by Bellowing Thunder hits an opponent, it will decrease their Electro RES by 15% for 8s.

sections.title: C3 · Distant Crackling
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Bellowing Thunder by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Fickle Cloudstrike
sections.body: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by Lightning Blade, if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

sections.title: C5 · Clamor in the Wilds
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Lightning Blade by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · World-Shaker
sections.body: Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by Bellowing Thunder will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, which will deal 200% of its original DMG and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character.

sections.title: Passive · Thunderflash
sections.body: When another nearby character in the party obtains an Abundance Amulet created by Lightning Blade, Lightning Blade's CD is decreased by 1.5s.

sections.title: Passive · Resounding Roar
sections.body: Increases the Energy Recharge effect granted by Lightning Blade's Abundance Amulet by 10% of the Traveler's Energy Recharge.

sections.title: Passive · Foreign Thundertrail
sections.body:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs.

In addition, when nearby party members unleash an Elemental Burst, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Resounding Thunder, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Resounding Thunder, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Resounding Thunder and transform into the special Charged Attack: Detonate.

Charged Attack: Detonate
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Electro DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 100% of Traveler's ATK. 
· 3s after hitting the enemy, 1 additional lightning strike will be triggered, dealing Electro DMG equal to 200% of Traveler's ATK. 1 Abundance Amulet will also be created. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· Charged Attack: Detonate can be triggered up to once every 15s.

title: Traveler · Razorgrass Blade
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Razorgrass Blade
sections.body:
With a flourish of your blade, you unleash a spray of razor-sharp leaves that go before you and deal Dendro DMG.

You and Paimon observed the flowing edges of grass and leaf.

sections.title: Elemental Burst · Surgent Manifestation
sections.body:
Calling upon the might of the flora all around you, you create a Lea Lotus Lamp.
This Lamp will deal continuous Dendro DMG to opponents within its AoE.

Lotuslight Transfiguration
The Lea Lotus Lamp will undergo the following changes after it comes into contact with Hydro/Electro/Pyro:
·Hydro: the Lamp's AoE and the AoE of its attacks are increased.
·Electro: the Lamp's ATK SPD is increased.
·Pyro: the Lamp will explode after a short delay and then disappear, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
The Lea Lotus Lamp can only undergo one Lotuslight Transfiguration in its duration.

Only one Lamp created by the Traveler can exist at any one time.

You and Paimon studied the sounds of plants that sprout after the rain.

sections.title: C1 · Symbiotic Creeper
sections.body: After Razorgrass Blade hits an opponent, it will regenerate 3.5 Energy for the Traveler.

sections.title: C2 · Green Resilience
sections.body: Lea Lotus Lamp's duration is increased by 3s.

sections.title: C3 · Whirling Weeds
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Razorgrass Blade by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C4 · Treacle Grass
sections.body:
After the Lea Lotus Lamp triggers a Lotuslight Transfiguration, it will obtain 5 stacks of the Overflowing Lotuslight effect from the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."

sections.title: C5 · Viridian Transience
sections.body:
Increases the Level of Surgent Manifestation by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

sections.title: C6 · Withering Aggregation
sections.body: The Dendro DMG Bonus of the character under the effect of Overflowing Lotuslight as created by the Lea Lotus Lamp is increased by 12%. If the Lamp has experienced a Lotuslight Transfiguration previously, the character will also gain 12% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element.

sections.title: Passive · Verdant Overgrowth
sections.body: Lea Lotus Lamp will obtain one level of Overflowing Lotuslight every second it is on the field, increasing the Elemental Mastery of active character(s) within its AoE by 6. Overflowing Lotuslight has a maximum of 10 stacks.

sections.title: Passive · Verdant Luxury
sections.body: Every point of Elemental Mastery the Traveler possesses increases the DMG dealt by Razorgrass Blade by 0.15% and the DMG dealt by Surgent Manifestation by 0.1%.

sections.title: Passive · Foreign Verdalume
sections.body:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs. 

Additionally, when Dendro Cores (including Bountiful Cores, Seeds of Deceit) appear nearby on the field, or when the party obtains Verdant Dew, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis. These two methods can each grant the Traveler up to 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis every 4s, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis and transform into the special Charged Attack: Verdessence.

Charged Attack: Verdessence
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased Dendro DMG. The increase in DMG is equal to 80% of Traveler's ATK. Two Vinecores will also be created on the spot, which will explode after 4/8s respectively, inflicting Dendro DMG equal to 120% of Traveler's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· Charged Attack: Verdessence can be triggered up to once every 15s.

title: Manekin · Punishing Barrage
summary: Build cards, guides, skills and constellations.

sections.title: Elemental Skill · Punishing Barrage
sections.body:
The Manekin attacks nearby opponents once, dealing AoE DMG corresponding to their own Elemental Type before pulling back rapidly. After unleashing an Elemental Skill, the Manekin's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to deal the corresponding elemental DMG, which cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, for a period of time. This effect will disappear when the Manekin leaves the field.

Has 2 charges.

"A well-measured blow is a necessary warning."

sections.title: Elemental Burst · No Entry
sections.body:
The Manekin summons a "Restricted Area" that follows them around, dealing 1 instance of DMG corresponding to the Manekin's Elemental Type to nearby opponents.
Additionally, when opponents enter the Restricted Area, they will receive 1 instance of DMG corresponding to the Manekin's Elemental Type. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
The Restricted Area will disappear when the Manekin leaves the field.

"Those who insist on trespassing within the restricted area will be regarded as hostile and expelled with maximum force."

sections.title: Passive · Battlelines Redrawn
sections.body: When the Manekin leaves the field, if a Restricted Area that they summoned is still active, it will explode, dealing AoE DMG of the Manekin's Elemental Type equal to 200% of the Manekin's ATK.

sections.title: Passive · Combat Readiness
sections.body: When the Manekin is not on the field and their Elemental Energy is below 30%, they will recover 2 Elemental Energy per second.

sections.title: Passive · Agile Stance
sections.body: When the Manekin unleashes an Elemental Skill or Burst, it will change to one of its existing Cosmetic Plans at random.
